content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis not specified",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of Study 20190009 is progression-free Survival (PFS).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2 Primary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint PFS is described, but no statistical analysis method (e.g., Kaplan-Meier, Cox model) is stated in the provided text. The protocol should specify the analysis for the primary endpoint.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed statistical analysis section for PFS, including the estimation method, hypothesis testing, and censoring rules."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Attributes Secondary Estimand - PRO",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PRO estimand lists target population, endpoint, summary measure, and intercurrent events, but the variable (specific PRO measure) is not explicitly defined in the attributes. Also, the estimand for DOR, TTR, and DCR is not provided.",
      "fix": "Specify the variable for each PRO estimand and add estimand attributes for DOR, TTR, and DCR."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis stated for DOR, TTR, and DCR",
      "quote": "To compare efficacy of AMG 510 versus docetaxel as assessed by: duration of response (DOR), time to response (TTR), and disease control rate (DCR)",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The objectives list DOR, TTR, and DCR as secondary endpoints, but no corresponding analysis methods or estimands are described in the provided text.",
      "fix": "Add statistical analysis methods and estimand attributes for DOR, TTR, and DCR."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for PRO endpoints",
      "quote": "Change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12 in disease related symptoms",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PRO endpoints are defined, but the protocol does not specify how missing PRO data will be handled (e.g., imputation methods, mixed models for repeated measures).",
      "fix": "Include a section on missing data handling for PRO endpoints, specifying the analysis model and imputation approach."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity not addressed for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The key secondary endpoints are OS, objective response rate (ORR), patient-reported outcomes (PRO)",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.3 Key Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lists multiple key secondary endpoints but does not describe how to control the family-wise error rate (e.g., hierarchical testing, alpha allocation).",
      "fix": "Add a multiplicity control strategy for the key secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inputs not provided",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of Study 20190009 is progression-free Survival (PFS).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2 Primary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not include any sample size calculation or justification in the provided text, which is a critical omission for a statistical section.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section with assumptions (e.g., effect size, alpha, power, dropout rate) and the calculated sample size."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistency in PFS definition between sections",
      "quote": "Progression will be based on blinded independent central review (BICR) of disease response per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1).",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "In Section 2.1.2, PFS is based on 'independent radiologic assessment' while in Section 3 it is 'blinded independent central review (BICR)'. These terms may be consistent but should be unified for clarity.",
      "fix": "Use consistent terminology for the independent review (e.g., BICR) throughout the protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "PRO estimand intercurrent events strategy unclear",
      "quote": "PRO measurements before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy including crossover will be used to estimate treatment effect.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "advisory",
      "explanation": "The strategy for intercurrent events in the PRO estimand is described, but it is not clear whether this is a treatment policy or hypothetical strategy. Clarifying the estimand strategy would improve alignment with ICH E9 (R1).",
      "fix": "Explicitly state the estimand strategy (e.g., treatment policy) for PRO endpoints."
    }
  ]
}
